sv.title: TV4 låser in SHL i långt avtal
sv.summary: TV4 tecknar ett nytt flerårsavtal med Svenska Hockeyligan, SHL. Nu ska sport i tv-sofforna göra tv-bolaget till landets största streamingstjänst, enligt TV4-chefen.

en.title: TV4 locks in the SHL with a long contract
en.summary: TV4 signs a new multi-year agreement with the Swedish Hockey League, SHL. Now sport in the TV sofas is to make the broadcaster the country's largest streaming service, according to the TV4 chief.
